description: Get the products the user buys most often, counted over their Albert Heijn delivery orders and in-store receipts (kassabonnen) of the last few months. purchase_count is the number of orders and store visits that included the product, split into online_count and in_store_count. Use it to suggest a shopping list or spot staples that are on bonus. Returns product_name, product_id, the counts and last_purchased_date, most bought first. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

min_purchase_count.description: Only products bought at least this many times (default 3)

months.description: How many months back to count (default 3, max 12)

source.description: Count delivery orders, store receipts, or both (default all)

name: ah_get_frequent_items
title: Albert Heijn: Frequently Bought Items
